g.desc: Physical application component: Bank Payment Journey (The application as a whole). It composes Payment service; composes Risk engine; composes Core connector; composes Settlement worker; composes Notification worker.

Physical application component APP-001: Payment service (service). In Channel & customer. It realizes Payment API; implements Payment initiation (request); uses Check; hands Risk engine “Check” (sync). Bank Payment Journey composes it.

Physical application component APP-002: Risk engine (service). In Control & accounting. It realizes Risk screening; implements Check (request); uses Allow; hands Core connector “Allow” (sync). Bank Payment Journey composes it; Payment service hands it “Check” (sync).

Physical application component APP-003: Core connector (adapter). In Control & accounting. It realizes Core ledger; implements Allow (request); uses Ledger posting; uses Handoff; hands Settlement worker “Handoff” (sync). Bank Payment Journey composes it; Risk engine hands it “Allow” (sync).

Physical application component APP-004: Settlement worker (worker). In Settlement. It realizes Settlement hub; implements Handoff (request); uses Settlement submission and enquiry; uses Event; hands Notification worker “Event” (event). Bank Payment Journey composes it; Core connector hands it “Handoff” (sync).

Physical application component APP-005: Notification worker (worker). In Channel & customer. It realizes Notification service; implements Event (event). Bank Payment Journey composes it; Settlement worker hands it “Event” (event).
Logical application component LR-001: Payment API. In Channel & customer. Payment service realizes it.
Logical application component LR-002: Risk screening. In Control & accounting. Risk engine realizes it.
Logical application component LR-003: Core ledger. In Control & accounting. Core connector realizes it.
Logical application component LR-004: Settlement hub. In Settlement. Settlement worker realizes it.
Logical application component LR-005: Notification service. In Channel & customer. Notification worker realizes it.
Application service IF-001: Payment initiation (POST /payments · illustrative · HTTPS / JSON · illustrative). Payment service implements it (request); Initiating channel uses it.
Application service IF-002: Ledger posting. In Core banking authority. Core connector uses it.
Application service IF-003: Settlement submission and enquiry. In External payment network. Settlement worker uses it.
Application service IF-004: Check. Risk engine implements it (request); Payment service uses it.
Application service IF-005: Allow. Core connector implements it (request); Risk engine uses it.
Application service IF-006: Handoff. Settlement worker implements it (request); Core connector uses it.
Application service IF-007: Event. Notification worker implements it (event); Settlement worker uses it.
Physical application component: Initiating channel (External caller). It uses Payment initiation.
